source.source_version: Official FSA Beginning Farmers and Ranchers Loans page retrieved 2026-10-29; publisher revision date not stated

mappings.statement: A beginning farmer has not operated a farm or ranch for more than 10 years.
A beginning farmer does not own a farm or ranch greater than 30 percent of the average size farm in the county, using the most current Census of Agriculture when the loan application is submitted.
mappings.unresolved_reason: The profile and catalog do not yet provide the county-specific current Census farm-size comparison needed to evaluate this limit.

mappings.statement: A beginning farmer substantially participates in the operation.
mappings.unresolved_reason: The phrase requires a source-backed operational definition and additional profile facts.

mappings.statement: A beginning farmer must also meet the eligibility requirements of the specific Farm Operating Loan, Farm Ownership Loan, or Microloan being requested.
mappings.unresolved_reason: The loan product has not been selected and its product-specific criteria are not mapped in this slice.

evaluation_boundary: This evaluates only the source-published beginning-farmer operation-years criterion. It does not establish qualification for any FSA loan; all other mapped and unmapped requirements remain in the result as partial or unknown.
